import sqlite3, json, os, re
base='/home/box/agent-data/agents/cfde06bf-ba71-4db5-b377-4a6904467ce6'
con=sqlite3.connect(os.path.join(base,'store.db'))
cur=con.cursor()
print('==== KV ====')
for k,v in cur.execute('SELECT key, value FROM kv'):
    vs=v if isinstance(v,str) else (v.decode('utf-8','replace') if isinstance(v,bytes) else str(v))
    print(k, ':', vs[:500])
    print('---')

print('\n==== TRANSCRIPT TYPES ====')
types={}
samples=[]
for seq,id_,entry in cur.execute('SELECT seq,id,entry FROM transcript_entries ORDER BY seq'):
    try:
        e=json.loads(entry) if isinstance(entry,str) else json.loads(entry.decode('utf-8'))
    except Exception as ex:
        print('parse fail', seq, ex)
        continue
    t=e.get('type') or e.get('role') or list(e.keys())[:6]
    types[str(t)]=types.get(str(t),0)+1
    if seq<=8 or seq>=85:
        samples.append((seq,e))
print(types)
print('\n==== FIRST/LAST ENTRIES (keys) ====')
for seq,e in samples:
    print(seq, list(e.keys())[:20], 'type=', e.get('type'), 'role=', e.get('role'))
con.close()
